versions.content: Allocation of safety requirements to AUTOSAR elements Allocation of a safety requirement to AUTOSAR elements is expressed by means of a reference in the AdminData block that points to the AUTOSAR element. For each allocation reference, a sdx reference shall be listed in a combined Sdg element named gid=ALLOCATION .
